dog.description_text:
Meet Rocket!

Rocket is an adorable boy with a heart full of love and a personality that’s impossible to forget. This sweet guy absolutely loves to curl up and cuddle, making him the perfect companion for cozy days and moments together.

Rocket is also wonderfully wiggly and has a one of a kind bark-yowl that you truly have to hear to believe! His unique little voice is just one of the many things that makes him so special.

If you're looking for a loving cuddle buddy with plenty of personality and the sweetest wiggles, Rocket is ready to rocket his way into your heart!

﻿*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
